# Build SIBEC prediction model
Uses SIBEC data plus other bounding data sets to create a machine learning regression model of site index and applies to build a predicted SIBEC and a more expansive model for use in climate change forecasting.
May also want a survival model to predict mortality and combine the two models into a predicted 'volume' model for use in the portfolio analysis.
This is probably required with the AMAT and other observation that often a few surviving individuals will have surprising high site index values.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
#options(tinytex.verbose = TRUE)
require(tidyverse)
#require (ggplot2)
require (assertr)

#require(climr)

library(purrr)
require(tictoc)
require(tidymodels)

library(stacks)  # Model stacking
library(gt)
require(mgcv)  # Generalized additive models)
```

##Import SIBEC data

Read in SIBEC data saved from SIBEC_data_prep.Rmd scripts

```{r SIBEC data import}
sibec.anal <- readRDS("./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.rds") %>% 
 # mutate(SNR = as.numeric(factor(rSNR, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), ordered = TRUE))) %>% 
  mutate(SNR = as.integer(
      factor(SNR, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F")))) %>% 
  #mutate(rSMR = as.integer(
   #   factor(rSMR, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5","6","7","8")))) %>%
  mutate(
    DD5 = as.numeric(DD5_an),
    CMD.adj = as.numeric(CMD.adj))

predictors <- c("DD5_an", "SNR", "CMD.adj", "PAS_an", "CMI_an", "bFFP", "DD18_an", "Eref_an","rSMR", "VPD_sm")#,"aSMR",
###For random forests probably need some bounding data otherwise no extrapolation into sites outside the training data
###Ensemble models may be better for extrapolation but challenges in getting to prediction 

sibec.coast <- sibec.anal %>% filter(Zone %in% c("CWH", "MH", "CDF"))
sibec.interior <- sibec.anal %>% filter(!Zone %in% c("CWH", "MH", "CDF")) 
## select set for running models
sibec.tst = sibec.coast
# Step 1: Calculate non-zero SI50 count per TreeSpp
valid_species <- sibec.tst %>%
  filter(SI50 > 0) %>%
  count(TreeSpp) %>%
  filter(n >= 50) %>%
  pull(TreeSpp)

# Step 2: Filter main dataset to retain only those species
sibec.tst <- sibec.tst %>%
  filter(TreeSpp %in% valid_species)

xx <- sibec.tst %>% filter(BGC == "ESSFmcw")
```

## Generate boxplots of site index by site series with phases
This produces a facetted boxplot graph for each species in a BGC showing site index by site series

```{r boxplot species by rSMRxSNR}

SI_spp <- sibec.tst %>% arrange(BGC)#%>% filter(grepl("^SBSmc2", BECSiteUnit))
SI_spp <- drop_na (SI_spp)
# Create separate plots for each BGC
unique_bgcs <- sort(unique(SI_spp$BGC))
unique_bgcs = "CWHdm"
for (bgc in unique_bgcs) {
  # Filter data for the current BGC
  SI_spp_subset <- SI_spp %>% filter(BGC == bgc)
  
  # Create the plot
SI_plot <- ggplot(SI_spp_subset, aes(x=eda1, y=SI50, fill=rSNRg)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8,angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80")
  ) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Site Index by edatopic position ", bgc)) +
  facet_wrap(~TreeSpp)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50))

  plot(SI_plot)
  # Save the plot
  #ggsave(filename = paste0("./outputs/SiteIndex_", bgc, "_rSMR.png"), plot = SI_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
}

```

```{r}
species_metrics <- list()
species_predictions <- list()
final_models <- list(
  rf = list(),
  gam = list(),
  stack = list()
)
model_list <- list(
  rf = list(),
  gam = list(),
  stack = list()
)
species_list <- unique(sibec.anal2$TreeSpp)
#species_list = "Fd"
for(species in species_list){

  cat(species, "\n")

  spp_data <- sibec.anal2 %>%
    filter(TreeSpp == species)

  if(nrow(spp_data) < 50) next

  #-----------------------------
  # Train / Assessment split
  #-----------------------------

  # split_obj <- initial_split(
  #   spp_data,
  #   prop = 0.8,
  #   strata = purpose
  # )
  # 
  split_obj <-group_initial_split(
  spp_data,
  group = BGC,
  prop = 0.8
)

  train_tbl <- training(split_obj)
  assess_tbl <- testing(split_obj)

  cv_folds <- vfold_cv(
    train_tbl,
    v = 5,
    strata = purpose
  )
    
  model_recipe <- recipe(
    reformulate(predictors, response = "SI50"),
    data = train_tbl
  ) %>%
    step_interact(~ rSMR:SNR)
  
    
  rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(model_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      rand_forest(
        trees = 500
      ) %>%
        set_engine(
          "ranger",
          importance = "permutation"
        ) %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )
      
    xgb_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(model_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      boost_tree(
        trees = 200
      ) %>%
        set_engine("xgboost") %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )
        
      svm_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(model_recipe) %>%
    add_model(
      svm_rbf() %>%
        set_engine("kernlab") %>%
        set_mode("regression")
    )
      
        ctrl <- control_resamples(
    save_pred = TRUE,
    save_workflow = TRUE
  )

  rf_res <- fit_resamples(
    rf_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )

  xgb_res <- fit_resamples(
    xgb_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )

  svm_res <- fit_resamples(
    svm_wf,
    cv_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq),
    control = ctrl
  )
  
    stack_fit <- stacks() %>%
    add_candidates(xgb_res) %>%
    add_candidates(rf_res) %>%
    add_candidates(svm_res) %>%
    blend_predictions() %>%
    fit_members()
    
      rf_fit <- fit(
    rf_wf,
    train_tbl
  )
      
        gam_fit <- mgcv::gam(
    SI50 ~
      s(CMD.adj, k = 10) +
      s(DD5_an, k = 10) +
      s(CMI_an, k = 10) +
      s(DD18_an, k = 10) +
      s(Eref_an, k = 10) +
      s(PAS_an, k = 10) +
      s(bFFP, k = 10) +
      s(VPD_sm, k=10)+
      s(rSMR, bs = "cr", k = 5) +
    s(SNR, bs = "cr", k = 5)+
    ti(rSMR, SNR, k = c(5,5)),
    data = train_tbl,
    method = "REML",
    select = TRUE
  )

  rf_pred <- predict(
    rf_fit,
    assess_tbl
  )$.pred

  gam_pred <- predict(
    gam_fit,
    newdata = assess_tbl
  )
    
  stack_pred <- predict(
    stack_fit,
    new_data = assess_tbl
  )$.pred
  
    metric_df <- tibble(
    TreeSpp = species,
    Model = c(
      "RF",
      "GAM",
      "STACK"
    ),
    R2 = c(
      cor(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred)^2,
      cor(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred)^2,
      cor(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred)^2
    ),
    RMSE = c(
      rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred),
      rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred),
      rmse_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred)
    ),
    MAE = c(
      mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, rf_pred),
      mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, gam_pred),
      mae_vec(assess_tbl$SI50, stack_pred)
    ),
    n = nrow(assess_tbl)
  )

  species_metrics[[species]] <- metric_df
  print(metric_df)
  cat(
  species,
  "RF =", round(metric_df$R2[metric_df$Model=="RF"],3),
  "GAM =", round(metric_df$R2[metric_df$Model=="GAM"],3),
  "STACK =", round(metric_df$R2[metric_df$Model=="STACK"],3),
  "\n"
)
  
    species_predictions[[species]] <- bind_rows(

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Model = "RF",
      SI50 = assess_tbl$SI50,
      Pred = rf_pred
    ),

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Model = "GAM",
      SI50 = assess_tbl$SI50,
      Pred = gam_pred
    ),

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Model = "STACK",
      SI50 = assess_tbl$SI50,
      Pred = stack_pred
    )

  )
  model_list$rf[[species]] <- rf_fit
  model_list$gam[[species]] <- gam_fit
  model_list$stack[[species]] <- stack_fit
  
  full_recipe <- recipe(
  reformulate(predictors, response = "SI50"),
  data = spp_data
) %>%
  step_interact(~ rSMR:SNR)
  
  rf_final <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(full_recipe) %>%
  add_model(
    rand_forest(
      trees = 500
    ) %>%
      set_engine(
        "ranger",
        importance = "permutation"
      ) %>%
      set_mode("regression")
  ) %>%
  fit(spp_data)
  
  gam_final <- mgcv::gam(
  SI50 ~
    s(CMD.adj, k = 10) +
    s(DD5_an, k = 10) +
    s(CMI_an, k = 10) +
    s(DD18_an, k = 10) +
    s(Eref_an, k = 10) +
    s(PAS_an, k = 10) +
    s(bFFP, k = 10) +
    s(VPD_sm, k = 10) +
      s(rSMR, bs = "cr", k = 5) +
    s(SNR, bs = "cr", k = 5)+
    ti(rSMR, SNR, k = c(5,5)),
  data = spp_data,
  method = "REML",
  select = TRUE
)

  full_folds <- vfold_cv(
  spp_data,
  v = 10,
  strata = purpose
)
  rf_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  rf_wf,
  full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae),
  control = ctrl
)

xgb_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  xgb_wf,
  full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae),
  control = ctrl
)

svm_full_res <- fit_resamples(
  svm_wf,
  full_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae),
  control = ctrl
)
stack_final <- stacks() %>%
  add_candidates(xgb_full_res) %>%
  add_candidates(rf_full_res) %>%
  add_candidates(svm_full_res) %>%
  blend_predictions() %>%
  fit_members()
final_models$rf[[species]] <- rf_final
final_models$gam[[species]] <- gam_final
final_models$stack[[species]] <- stack_final
}

saveRDS(
  final_models,
  "./models/final_species_models.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  stack_final,
  paste0(
    "./models/stack_final_",
    species,
    ".rds"
  )
)
```


```{r}
final_metrics <-
  bind_rows(species_metrics)

all_predictions <-
  bind_rows(species_predictions)

best_models <-
  final_metrics %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp) %>%
  slice_max(
    R2,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )
gt::gt(best_models)

final_metrics %>%
  select(TreeSpp, Model, R2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Model,
    values_from = R2
  )

final_metrics %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_R2 = mean(R2),
    Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    Mean_MAE = mean(MAE)
  )

ggplot(
  final_metrics,
  aes(
    y = TreeSpp,
    x = R2,
    fill = Model
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge()
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(
  final_metrics,
  aes(
    Model,
    TreeSpp,
    fill = R2
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(R2, 2)),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()
```
check variables importance to model

```{r}
rf_importance <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(final_models$rf),
  function(species){

    mod <- final_models$rf[[species]]

    imp <- mod %>%
      extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
      pluck("fit") %>%
      ranger::importance()

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Variable = names(imp),
      Importance = as.numeric(imp)
    )

  }
)

rf_importance %>%
  group_by(TreeSpp) %>%
  slice_max(
    Importance,
    n = 10
  ) %>%
  arrange(TreeSpp, desc(Importance))
ggplot(
  rf_importance,
  aes(
    Importance,
    reorder(Variable, Importance)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~TreeSpp, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r}
gam_importance <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(final_models$gam),
  function(species){

    s_tab <- summary(
      final_models$gam[[species]]
    )$s.table

    tibble(
      TreeSpp = species,
      Variable = rownames(s_tab),
      edf = s_tab[, "edf"],
      F = s_tab[, "F"],
      p = s_tab[, "p-value"]
    )

  }
)
gam_importance %>%
  arrange(
    TreeSpp,
    desc(F)
  )

ggplot(
  gam_importance,
  aes(
    x = Variable,
    y = TreeSpp,
    fill = log10(F + 1)
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "log10(F)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
